import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] comb = new long[62][62];
    static long[][] costA = new long[32][32];
    static long[][] costB = new long[32][32];
    static int R, C, L;
    static char[] dir;
    static long total;
    static long diff;
    static long res;
    static ArrayList<long[]>[] store1 = new ArrayList[32][2];
    static ArrayList<long[]>[] store2 = new ArrayList[32][2];
    static long[][] cnt = new long[32][32];

    static void store_fwd(int x, int y, long gain, long c1, long c2, boolean flg) {
        if (x + y == L) {
            store1[x][flg ? 1 : 0].add(new long[]{gain, c1});
            if (c2 != 0) store2[x][flg ? 1 : 0].add(new long[]{gain, c2});
            return;
        }
        if (x + 1 <= L)
            store_fwd(x+1, y, gain + (!flg ? costA[x+1][y] : 0), c1, (dir[x+y] != 'B' ? c2 : 0), flg);
        if (y + 1 <= L)
            store_fwd(x, y+1, gain + (flg ? costB[x][y+1] : 0), c1, (dir[x+y] != 'A' ? c2 : 0), flg);
    }

    static void forward_search(int x, int y, long sum, boolean flg) {
        if (x + y == L) {
            if (store1[x][flg ? 1 : 0].isEmpty()) return;
            long target = (total + 1) / 2 - sum;
            int lb = lowerBound(store1[x][flg ? 1 : 0], target);
            for (int i = lb; i < store1[x][flg ? 1 : 0].size() && i - lb < 2; i++) {
                if (store1[x][flg ? 1 : 0].get(i)[1] <= 0) continue;
                long cur = Math.abs((store1[x][flg ? 1 : 0].get(i)[0] + sum) * 2 - total);
                if (cur < diff) diff = cur;
            }
            if (lb > 0) {
                int it = lb - 1;
                if (store1[x][flg ? 1 : 0].get(it)[1] > 0) {
                    long cur = Math.abs((store1[x][flg ? 1 : 0].get(it)[0] + sum) * 2 - total);
                    if (cur < diff) diff = cur;
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if (x > 0) forward_search(x-1, y, sum + (!flg ? costA[x][y] : 0), flg);
        if (y > 0) forward_search(x, y-1, sum + (flg ? costB[x][y] : 0), flg);
    }

    static void backward_search(int x, int y, long sum, boolean flg) {
        if (x + y == L) {
            int lb = lowerBound(store2[x][flg ? 1 : 0], (total + 1) / 2 - sum);
            for (int i = lb; i < store2[x][flg ? 1 : 0].size() && i - lb < 2; i++) {
                if (store2[x][flg ? 1 : 0].get(i)[1] <= 0) continue;
                long cur = Math.abs((store2[x][flg ? 1 : 0].get(i)[0] + sum) * 2 - total);
                if (cur == diff) res += store2[x][flg ? 1 : 0].get(i)[1];
            }
            if (lb > 0) {
                int it = lb - 1;
                if (store2[x][flg ? 1 : 0].get(it)[1] > 0) {
                    long cur = Math.abs((store2[x][flg ? 1 : 0].get(it)[0] + sum) * 2 - total);
                    if (cur == diff) res += store2[x][flg ? 1 : 0].get(it)[1];
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if (x > 0 && dir[x+y-1] != 'B') backward_search(x-1, y, sum + (!flg ? costA[x][y] : 0), flg);
        if (y > 0 && dir[x+y-1] != 'A') backward_search(x, y-1, sum + (flg ? costB[x][y] : 0), flg);
    }

    static void merge(ArrayList<long[]> v) {
        if (v.isEmpty()) return;
        Collections.sort(v, (a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
        ArrayList<long[]> tmp = new ArrayList<>();
        long last = v.get(0)[0];
        long accum = 0;
        for (long[] p : v) {
            if (p[0] == last) accum += p[1];
            else {
                tmp.add(new long[]{last, accum});
                last = p[0];
                accum = p[1];
            }
        }
        tmp.add(new long[]{last, accum});
        v.clear();
        v.addAll(tmp);
    }

    static int lowerBound(ArrayList<long[]> list, long target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid)[0] < target) low = mid + 1;
            else high = mid;
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        R = sc.nextInt();
        C = sc.nextInt();
        dir = sc.next().toCharArray();
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; ++i) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) comb[i][j] = comb[i-1][j-1] + comb[i-1][j];
        }
        
        L = R + C;
        total = comb[L*2][R*2];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= L; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= L; ++j) {
                if (i > 0) costA[i][j] = comb[i-1][R-1] * (comb[L*2-i][R] - comb[j][R]);
                if (j > 0) costB[i][j] = comb[j-1][R-1] * (comb[L*2-j][R] - comb[i][R]);
            }
        }
        
        cnt[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= L; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= L; ++j) {
                if (i < L && dir[i+j] != 'B') cnt[i+1][j] += cnt[i][j];
                if (j < L && dir[i+j] != 'A') cnt[i][j+1] += cnt[i][j];
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
            store1[i][0] = new ArrayList<>();
            store1[i][1] = new ArrayList<>();
            store2[i][0] = new ArrayList<>();
            store2[i][1] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        for (int i = R; i <= L; ++i) {
            if (dir[i+R-1] != 'B') store_fwd(R, i, costA[R][i], comb[i+R-1][R-1], cnt[R-1][i], false);
            if (dir[i+R-1] != 'A') store_fwd(i, R, costB[i][R], comb[i+R-1][R-1], cnt[i][R-1], true);
        }
        
        for (int i = R; i <= L; ++i) {
            merge(store1[i][0]);
            merge(store1[i][1]);
            merge(store2[i][0]);
            merge(store2[i][1]);
        }
        
        diff = total + 1;
        forward_search(L, L, 0, false);
        forward_search(L, L, 0, true);
        backward_search(L, L, 0, false);
        backward_search(L, L, 0, true);
        
        System.out.println(res);
    }
}
